scope: grass generation chain (8 compute + generate_grass + grass_common.inc + 3 grass rasters) + clearing/billboard vegetation rasters (distant_billboard, instanced_background_tree, meadow_flower, meadow_plant, tree_canopy, tree_trunk + canopy_vert.inc + inc/{instanced_placement, canopy_common, forest_floor}) + billboard_forest, billboard_plant

validation.acceptance: HARD GATE: bindings + entry + LocalSize + capabilities must match; opcode_histogram converge <=3 rounds, residuals recorded

hard_gate_pass: 19/19 main bins (bindings+entry+LocalSize+capabilities match on every b903 vs and ps module)

residual_classes.OpSource/OpString: systematic -1: original build wraps each shader in a temp include file (input path separate from the main-file OpSource); direct recompile has one fewer OpSource. Recorded, not chased.
residual_classes.OpLine/OpNoLine: debug line markers differ (source line layout unknown); not chased.
residual_classes.OpSwitch/OpUnreachable/Label: original dxc (16ceb560) compiles if/else + do-while(false) breaks to OpSwitch; installed dxc (1.10.2605.37) emits BranchConditional/phi (RECOVERY_TRACKER #17 version drift).
residual_classes.matrix element access: original loads whole float4x4 then OpCompositeExtract rows; installed dxc emits per-element OpAccessChain+OpLoad (calc_tiles, generate_grass).
residual_classes.twist/Rodrigues fold: original dxc does not fold the Rodrigues matrix constants; installed dxc folds them (grass.raster/lod1 FMul/FAdd gap).
residual_classes.RWByteAddressBuffer byte offset: original emits OpBitcast int-dance for byte offsets; installed dxc folds (bundles/tiles_prefix).
residual_classes.StructuredBuffer struct emission: instanced_background_tree target emits the PlacementData struct type (OpMemberName/OpTypeStruct); candidate DCEs it (buffer used via byte loads) - residual.
residual_classes.inc/lighting.hlsl omission: inc/lighting.hlsl references color_library.indirect_light_tint (nested form) which conflicts with this family's flat-member color_library cbuffer; lighting.hlsl is unused in these shaders so it is omitted (-1 OpSource) and the issue flagged for INC-C.

inc_issues: inc/lighting.hlsl (INC-C) references `color_library.indirect_light_tint` (nested struct form). Consumers that bind the original flat-member color_library cbuffer (billboard_forest/plant, meadow_plant, tree_canopy/trunk, instanced_background_tree, generate_grass, distant_billboard) cannot include it; the nested access should be a flat `indirect_light_tint` reference to match the embedded flat cbuffer (struct 45 = 37 flat members in billboard_forest).
inc/scatter.hlsl (INC-B) scatter_point() references $Globals member `scatter_grid_dim`; generate_grass (which only uses scatter_cell_point) needs a static stand-in declaration to compile.
inc/blue_noise.hlsl (INC-B) declares blue_noise_texture at t14; tree_canopy binds it at t21 and samples directly, so blue_noise.hlsl is omitted there (-1 OpSource).

inc/color_library.hlsl (INC-C) declares the cbuffer at a placeholder b14 with a nested member; several consumers need the flat-member cbuffer at their own binding (b13/b18/b24) - consumers guard-skip and redeclare flat.
